Name: Chubby Bachelorettes
Author: Syableman1
Description:
A Sprite and Portrait replacer, for all six currently eligible bachelorettes. All five are contained individually, so you can choose which ones should gain weight. .png's are included, so you may edit them yourself if you wish.
Credit for the revealed cleavage in the portraits: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/lewd-bachelorettes-portrait-mod-buxom-haley-added.108210/
I would link to the Nexus page, but it seems to have been shutdown :/
